changelog: Fixes links that fetched fine but sat on buffering forever and never started
Root cause found against the live CDN: MovieBox stream requests carried a Referer header, and the CDN rejects those with 429 Too Many Requests, so ExoPlayer retried instead of playing

Referer/Origin now stripped for MovieBox CDN links in all three places that were adding them (extractor, header resolver, streaming client), so every link still plays with the rest of its player's settings
Verified live for a movie and a series: MP4 answers 200 video/mp4, DASH manifest 200 with its signCookie
CineStream (MovieBox) player runs movies and series by default, with other players still available from Search More Players
